name: reproducible-science
description: Freeze a plan before running, seal a run's inputs, bind every number and quotation in a manuscript to what backs it, and check that each still resolves before submitting. Bundles prereg, citations, results and repro.

interface.shortDescription: Check a paper against its data
interface.longDescription: Freeze a plan before running, seal a run's inputs, bind every number and quotation in a manuscript to what backs it, and check that each still resolves before submitting. The plugin carries the skills for prereg, citations, results and repro, the repro MCP server, and hooks that refuse an edit to a frozen preregistration.
